messages:
Maia Brooks: Quick sync on a densified compare row prototype. Trying to make rows tighter for power users; added keyboard pin shortcut and condensed perf badge. Screenshot: https://figs.example.com/s/compact-compare-v2.png
Priya Nair: Visual looks good but the purple perf badge has low contrast on light. Can you run WCAG numbers?
Alex Rivera: Concern: when we collapse, some metrics lose context. Suggest abbreviations + hover tooltips for p50/p95 and tokens per request.
Maia Brooks: Idea: columns = name | perf badge (p95) | pin. Hidden metrics become aria-hidden until focus; expand with Space/Enter.
Jon Chen: Keyboard: prefer using Enter/Space for the pin so SR users get familiar patterns. `K` as a global quick-pin is OK but must be discoverable in the shortcuts help.
Samir Patel: Copy nit: make the pin label explicit: "Pin version" or "Pinned version for compare". Single word "Pinned" is ambiguous when used as an action vs state.
DesignBot: Accessibility check: #9A73FF fails AA small text. Recommend #7B4BFF or add a 1px focus ring and ensure contrast with badge text.
Priya Nair: Also add aria-label to the pin control: "Toggle pin for {model} {version}" and use aria-pressed when toggled.
Alex Rivera: Badge semantics debate: UX wants latency (p95), infra wants cost. Proposal: badge shows p95 latency; tooltip or hover card shows cost estimate (tokens/sec, GPU cost).
Maia Brooks: We'll prototype that. Also experiment: control vs compact rows + keyboard `K`. Track time-to-pin, keyboard activations, and compare conversion.
Jon Chen: I'll draft the experiment metrics and a short PR for badge color semantics.
Samir Patel: Ensure tab order: name -> expand metrics -> pin -> actions. Also add a "Skip to compare" link at top of list for keyboard users.
Priya Nair: Microcopy suggestion for CTA: "Pin version (keeps this variant in compare)" — explicit but maybe long, happy to shorten if needed.
Maia Brooks: Prototype posted: https://figma.com/file/abc123. If no objections I'll open tickets tomorrow AM.
Alex Rivera: Screen reader announcement when pinned: "{Model} v{n} pinned for compare" using polite aria-live.
DesignBot: Created ticket UI-3431 for compact rows experiment and UI-3432 for badge color changes.
Maia Brooks: Thanks all — action items: Priya contrast + aria labels, Alex tooltip copy, Jon experiment spec + docs PR, Samir copy clarity. I'll file the tickets and link mocks.
